ExploitProtection.body:
Welcome to **ExploitProtection** discussions!

**Quick orientation**
- 🐛 Found a bug? Open a **Bug report** issue instead (structured form above).
- 🛡️ Vulnerability? Use **Report a vulnerability** on the Security tab — never a public issue.
- 📄 Want to add/verify mitigation entries? See CONTRIBUTING.md — the catalog (XploitProtection.xml) is the heart of this project.
- 💬 This forum is for questions, usage tips and hardening chat.

**Latest builds**: Releases tab — Windows standalone, auto-built.

— FrenzyPenguin Media 🛡️

Cripple-NetStrip.body:
Welcome to **NetStrip / Cripple** discussions!

**Quick orientation**
- 🐛 Bugs → **Bug report** issue with OS + version filled in.
- 🔐 Security issues → Security tab, private report.
- 🧭 Usage help (rules, blocklists, LAN Shield, Android VPN) → **Q&A** category here.
- 🚀 Release notes live in the Releases tab; full changelog in changelog.md.

**Ground rules**: no piracy talk; no attack traffic against systems you don't own.

— FrenzyPenguin Media 🕸️

BlackGlass.body:
Welcome to **BlackGlass** discussions — the multi-client Second Life chat viewer!

**Quick orientation**
- 🐛 Viewer bugs → **Bug report** issue (include viewer version + grid).
- 💬 Second Life chat/usage questions → **Q&A**.
- 🗺️ Teleporting, minimap or Lists tab ideas → **Ideas**.
- ⚠️ Reminder: comply with the Second Life ToS; use a test account when experimenting.

**Downloads**: Releases tab — Windows/macOS/Linux, auto-built from tags.

— FrenzyPenguin Media 👽

dnscrypt-proxy-gui.body:
Welcome to **dnscrypt-proxy GUI** discussions!

**Quick orientation**
- 🐛 GUI bugs → **Bug report** issue (OS + dnscrypt-proxy version please).
- 🌐 Resolver recommendations and encrypted-DNS questions → **Q&A**.
- 💡 Feature ideas (tray behavior, TOML editing UX…) → **Ideas**.
- ⚙️ The GUI manages dnscrypt-proxy — proxy core bugs belong upstream.

**Downloads**: Releases tab.

— FrenzyPenguin Media 🛡️
